title: One CI run per merge: the merge tool rebuilds the records page before the ready run
why: shiv, Oct 31 14:12 CDT owner ask (via coordinator [ended:Claude-settings-coordinator-handoff]): second in work order. Owner figure: 25 of 80 merges in the week to Oct 31 needed a second CI run (not measured by triage). One second run measured at about 28 min (#882, Oct 30 20:10 CDT).
note: Placed ahead of c52 and every other open step but trust-card-guard: owner ask, Oct 31 14:12 CDT. Lane open, draft #895; it waits on batch 37, which also edits merge/merge.py. Cause: merge/merge.py (commit_claim) adds a 'Claim record numbers' commit and a 'Rebuild the records page' commit after the PR's ready run, and the push starts CI again. Fix: claim the numbers and rebuild docs/records.md before the PR goes ready, so the ready run is the only run. Guard rule records-page still keeps lanes from committing docs/records.md; the merge tool does it. Done check: merge/test_merge.py cases show no push after the ready run on a PR that changes a record summary, red on main and green on the fix. Needs no answer. Files: merge/merge.py, merge/test_merge.py. Done: #895 in batch 39 #916, main d657e1da (coordinator, Oct 31 20:01 CDT). Repeat, Nov 1 20:48 CST: the merge tool still rebuilt and pushed on a ready PR (batch 60, PR #1009), restarting CI. Follow-up: step records-stale-refuses-on-ready. Reopened 06:30 CST Nov 10, third repeat: batch 71c (#2510) went green at 9c13cfd98 after about 3.5 h of macOS jobs. The merge then refused a stale records page, and runner 8 pushed the page as 85ccaf60d. That push restarted the whole run (coordinator 06:29 CST Nov 10). The refusal on a ready PR is on main (merge/merge.py line 16, origin/main 0e6509a96), so step records-stale-refuses-on-ready may be landed; check it. Gap left: nothing stops a PR going ready before the draft records step ran on its head. Fix: the ready route (pr-ready-mcp-cloud) or the merge tool's draft step refuses ready, or marks the head, until the rebuilt page equals the tree. Decision records-index-at-merge. Doing 06:31 CST Nov 10 in lane [ended:records-page-before-ready] (coordinator); the lane also checks whether records-stale-refuses-on-ready landed. #2542 released to the batch ( CST Nov 10, coordinator). Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was archived, handoff at handoffs/session_013NEJL1rJepBiu21f6Rv9jG.md on archive/session-handoffs-2026-11-10).
